definitions.explanation: The act of carefully examining something to ensure it is in proper condition.

examples.japanese: {架空|かくう}⟦{送電線|そうでんせん}→送電線：09776_soudensen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{点検|てんけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: To conduct an inspection of overhead power lines.

examples.japanese: ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{点検|てんけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：00488_ukeru⟧。
⟦{定期|ていき}→定期：02611_teiki⟧{点検|てんけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れないで→忘れる：00860_wasureru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please don't forget the regular inspection.

notes:
{点検|てんけん} is used for routine inspections and checks.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {点検|てんけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to conduct an inspection
- {点検|てんけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：00488_ukeru⟧: to undergo inspection
- ⟦{定期|ていき}→定期：02611_teiki⟧{点検|てんけん}: regular inspection
- {安全|あんぜん}{点検|てんけん}: safety inspection

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02716_kensa⟧: examination, test (more formal)
- ⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧: confirmation, verification
